fullContentHtml:
SSC JHT Exam City Details 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information :Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Exam City Details for the post of Junior Hindi Translator (JHT)/ Junior Translation Officer (JTO)/ Junior Translator (JT), Junior Translation Officer (JTO) & Senior Hindi Translator (SHT)/Senior Translator (ST)/ Senior Translation Officer (STO) on the official website. This recruitment has been issued for 303 posts. The online application process for SSC JHT Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 23 April 2026, to 14 May 2026. The Examination is going to conducted on 08 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SSC JHT Exam Date 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 April 2026
  • Last Date : 14 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 19-20 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 08 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 31 August 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 0/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
